name: Royal Grilled Fish
desc: A fish served whole from head to tail, and a dish that reflects the heartiness and quiet dignity of the frozen north. The fish is first marinated before grilling, then garnished with sides before serving. With a recipe said to have originated in Zapolyarny Palace, this elaborately prepared dish has since become a must-have at banquets across Snezhnaya.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 261 and healing effects by 8% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
